I addressed all six requested changes from the review on head `4739a4a6bf0b355575ed0c1abc6c216eb458355c`.

1. **Before/after UI screenshots (`crates/ui/`)**:
   I captured `1440x960` software-WGPU screenshots from `ShellUi` on `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`) and on this branch.
   I uploaded the four PNGs to `mkinney/Camcraft` `pr-screenshots` (`0fd64401cc4acd068a1ec9e048417002176a3f86`) and linked them in the PR body.
   No image or capture code is on this PR branch.
   `tests/tool_undercut.rs::slot_undercut_page_shows_its_geometry_heights_passes_and_feeds_fields` and `dovetail_properties_and_editor_edit_flank_angle_without_corner_radius` open the Slot Undercut page and tool editor.

2. **Dovetail flank angle, undercut defaults, and corner-radius filter (`crates/ui/`)**:
   I added `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_undercut_row.rs` (`seed` and `dovetail_row`) and wired it in `tool_settings.rs`.
   `seed` sets sane defaults and zero `corner_r` when switching to kinds `18..=21` (`TSlot`, `Keyseat`, `Dovetail`, `Lollipop`).
   `dovetail_row` renders `Flank angle (deg)` for `ToolKind::Dovetail`, and `tool_cutter_params.rs` renders `flank angle °`.
   `tool_settings.rs` hides `Corner radius` for all four undercut kinds.
   Pinned by: `tool_undercut_row::tests` (2 unit tests), `tool_undercut::new_tool_undercut_kinds_seed_sane_defaults_hide_corner_radius_and_show_dovetail_flank_angle`, `tool_undercut::dovetail_properties_and_editor_edit_flank_angle_without_corner_radius`, and `tool_cutter_params::each_milling_kind_shows_the_parameters_its_outline_is_drawn_from`.

3. **Keep neighbouring parts on part-source `SlotUndercut` (`crates/app/src/operation/keep_law.rs`)**:
   I added `OpParams::SlotUndercut(_)` to `is_part_kept_kind` so `neighbour_parts` and `kept_rejudge` check other setup parts.
   Pinned by: `tests/mcp_slot_undercut.rs::a_part_source_undercut_keeps_neighbouring_parts`.

4. **Preserve `0.0` `bulge` and `neck_slot` keys in JSON (`crates/app/src/project/undercut_dto.rs`)**:
   I removed `skip_serializing_if = "is_zero"` from `bulge` and `neck_slot` and removed `is_zero` while keeping `#[serde(default)]`.
   `list_operation_types` now exposes both fields, and `edit_operation` accepts `0.0` updates.
   Pinned by: `tests/mcp_slot_undercut.rs::list_operation_types_and_edit_operation_keep_zero_bulge_and_neck_slot`.

5. **Support undercut moves in Simulate playback (`crates/app/src/stock_play.rs`, `stock_play_head.rs`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/partial.rs`)**:
   I added `Stock::with_partial_undercut` via a shared `partial_cut_with` helper in `partial.rs`.
   I updated `PlayOp`, `PlayIndex::of`, `FieldPlay::from_seed`, `FieldPlay::cut`, and `FieldPlay::set_partial` to simulate `Planned::undercut`.
   Pinned by: `tests/stock_play.rs::playback_removes_undercut_head_and_neck_and_matches_field_view` and `tests/stock_play_partial.rs::partial_move_cuts_undercut_head_and_neck_on_a_copy`.

6. **Merge `upstream/main` conflict (`crates/app/src/operation/types/mod.rs`, `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/cut_twin_work.rs`)**:
   I merged `upstream/main` (`5ed5b7fe2`) and kept both `tilt_basis::CURRENT_TILT_BASIS` and `undercut::SlotUndercutOp`.
   I also handled `SdfTool::Dovetail` in `cut_twin_work::twin_tool` from upstream #2741.
